fakeObjects local namespace call counter, bucket tags and captured updates; no ObjectStorage client.

Narrow interfaces and local compartment regex guard; allocated fixtures inject fake implementations.
Query assembly, bounded page loop and local ResourceSummary mapping reach fakeSearch.
Merge copied tag maps, local equality guard, call selected fake writer with captured ETag.
Instance branch invokes injected fakeCompute.GetInstance/UpdateInstance; no SDK transport.
Bucket invokes fakeObjects via namespace; bucket update has no conditional ETag in SDK; unknown type returns local error.
Local namespace cache populated from fakeObjects.GetNamespace.
Local errors.As/status mapping into ErrChanged/ErrNotPermitted sentinels.
Injected leader/connect/clock and stubTagAPI list/retag capture; no actual OCI factory.
Local timer/context cancellation, leader predicate, cached injected API, pass counts, retries and failure text.
Local Resource/Stamp data, name/mark regex inference, age/type guards and PlanTags map output.
